facts.fact: RITA's presentation says e-RITA is a single digital platform that registers all vital events (births, deaths, marriages, divorces and adoptions) and is now the only system used for CRVS, the earlier silo systems having been eliminated; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

RITA says registration and certification are a one-stop process at local health facilities and community ward executive offices, and that health workers use mobile phones to send birth registration details to a central database, which enables real-time tracking; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

RITA reports that birth registration points rose from 139 in 2012 to over 12,025 in 2025, in health facilities and ward executive offices, with registration ongoing in all 26 regions; it gives no total of offices and does not say how many of the points enter the record digitally.

RITA presents e-RITA as its own single CRVS platform, run through local government authorities and health facilities, and names the financial and technical sustainability of the CRVS system as a remaining challenge; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

systems.country_label: e-RITA / eRITA, single digital platform for all vital events, with mobile-phone and Android applications for registration
systems.owner: Registration, Insolvency and Trusteeship Agency (RITA); mobile registration pioneered with Yas (Tigo) and UNICEF
systems.tiers: over 12,025 registration points in health facilities (maternity and RCH wards) and ward executive offices, all 26 regions

systems.system: integration of the civil registration system
systems.country_label: CR system integration completed with NIDA, Immigration, National Health Insurance Fund and Public Service Social Security Fund, and integration with HMIS, the Judiciary and NBS; merging of RITA and NIDA listed as an outcome

note: A slide deck; it also gives birth registration rates (about 10-12% in 2012, over 60% in 2022, 68% as of July 2024), which are shares of births and not of offices.
